newsitem.title: USA: Barringer Technologies says offer effective.
newsitem.headline: Barringer Technologies says offer effective.

text.p: Barringer Technologies Inc said Tuesday its filing to offer 1.25 million shares of common stock and 1.25 million common stock purchase warrants has been declared effective.
The common stock is being offered at 8-9/16, and the public warrants are being offered at $0.05, the company said.

Barringer Technologies is a holding company. Its subsidiaries are principally engaged in developing, manufacturing and marketing specialty analytical instruments for drugs and explosives detection applications.
